alerts.title: Marvel Tokon's Magik Gets Fired Up with Free New Costume for All Players
alerts.summary: Seeing red. If you're playing Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls , you'll probably be aware of the recent DLC and updates to the superhero fighter. Phoenix Cyclops has joined the roster as the first post-launch character, and to celebrate his arrival, developer Arc System Works has provided all players with a fun bonus. Read the full article on pushsquare.com
